title: How NSE helped Zerodha start when it had little money: Nithin Kamath recalls ahead of IPO
summary: Zerodha founder Nithin Kamath recalled how NSE’s free NSE NOW trading platform helped the brokerage start in 2010 when it lacked funds to build its own platform. He also said NSE waived Zerodha’s membership fee and was welcoming during its early days, expressing confidence that NSE’s much-awaited IPO will succeed.

title: India's forex reserves jump $44.90 billion to record $785.71 billion as of September 4
summary: India's foreign exchange reserves reached a record $785.71 billion. This surge followed a significant increase in the previous week. Foreign currency assets saw a substantial rise, contributing most to the growth. Gold reserves, however, experienced a slight decline during this period. Overall reserves show a considerable increase from both earlier this year and last year.

title: EU-India FTA: European Commission sends landmark trade deal to council for signature, paving way for ratification
summary: The European Commission has asked EU member states for approval to sign and conclude its landmark Free Trade Agreement with India, a deal that would eliminate or reduce tariffs on 96% of EU goods exports and save exporters an estimated €4 billion a year. Once cleared by the Council, the pact still needs European Parliament consent and India's own ratification before it can enter into force.
